meta.calendar_week_definition: Monday through Sunday by scheduled game date in Eastern Time
meta.grading_policy: Every frozen projection with a valid pregame market is graded for accountability. Disagreement labels are descriptive and are not promoted recommendation tiers.
meta.moneyline_policy: Prospective only from relative-market-fit-v1-2026-11-25: at least two complete books, 3 percentage-point no-vig edge, favorites -100 through -185, or model-favored underdogs +100 through +250.
meta.totals_policy: Total disagreements of 4+ points are tracked as testing keys; promotion eligibility remains separate.
meta.segment_tracking_policy: Data-only P5-vs-P5, Mid-Major-vs-Mid-Major, all-conference and all-team splits; no public UI or model influence.

interpretation.forecasting: Projection quality; lower MAE and bias nearer zero are better.
interpretation.model_favored: ATS/CLV for the side THI preferred when that side belonged to the conference or team.
interpretation.model_opposed: ATS/CLV for the THI-preferred opponent when THI opposed the conference or team.
interpretation.intra_conference: Both teams belonged to the same frozen conference at game time.
interpretation.ranking_guardrail: Do not rank raw hit rates without displaying n and the 95% interval; team samples are descriptive.
